Extension industrielle et déploiement de: Industrial expansion and deployment of the Chip-to-Chiller strategy
LG Electronics engage un montant total d: LG Electronics is committing a total of 150 billion South Korean won to increase its manufacturing volumes of air-cooled chillers. This investment program includes the construction of a new industrial complex in Windsor, Virginia, USA. With a built-up area of 30,000 square meters on a 170,000-square-meter plot, this plant will begin production during the first half of 2027. The facility aims to directly supply the North American market, which accounts for more than half of the world's data centers and features a strong presence of tech players in Virginia.
En parallèle, la firme augmente les capa: At the same time, the firm is increasing the capacities of its South Korean sites located in Pyeongtaek and Changwon. Industrial organization there is being optimized by the integration of a single-conveyor production system, facilitating the mass manufacturing of air-cooled chillers. As part of its "One LG" approach, the group is developing comprehensive solutions known as "Chip-to-Chiller." This portfolio integrates chillers, coolant distribution units, and cold plates designed to directly capture the heat generated by chips. According to research firm Omdia, the global capacity of data centers is expected to grow from 226 gigawatts in 2026 to 420 gigawatts.
